game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Geyser Flats Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before fire sprites spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before fire sprites spring the trap. Each round, fire sprites strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from fire sprites in Geyser Flats: keep the predictions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 38-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: predictions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 38-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 7 (applied tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 38 seconds while predictions > 0.
